g.text: PR #2384 · Keep Codex retries active and explain terminal failures
Retry errors lost their meaning; typed details now preserve activity and recovery.
Completion retains capacity errors, so the following frame cannot erase throttling.
BEFORE
AFTER
Notification::Error / TurnCompleted
Typed willRetry and codexErrorInfo arrive.
ErrorEvent retains only message.
Every error looks terminal
Dashboard goes Idle during a retry.
Edit stack can dispatch the next queued input.
Transcript draws a red error card.
turn.completed always means Idle
Terminal capacity details are unavailable.
Message follow also loses error state.
CodexErrorDetails
Preserves typed codexErrorInfo and willRetry.
ErrorEvent + TurnCompletedEvent carry details.
Retry remains ongoing work
Busy for retry; Throttled for capacity refusal.
Retry errors do not release queued input.
Muted retry status; terminal recovery hints.
Completion preserves capacity state
Dashboard and follow agree on Throttled.
Successful completion returns to Idle.
Old message-only archives remain terminal.
Tests cover metadata and completion ordering.
Future codes retain a generic visible fallback.
Follow, queue release and rendering are covered.
Scope: preserves provider signals; does not add automatic retries or change the provider's capacity limits.
